speaker: houston
text: Hi, crew! I'm Houston, NASA's Mission Control. We guide every flight from Earth.

speaker: houston
text: We can't fly your ship. We watch it from Earth and talk by radio.

speaker: houston
text: The game is based on Apollo 13. In 1970, a part broke on the way to the Moon.

speaker: houston
text: Houston and the crew solved it one problem at a time. All three came home alive.

speaker: houston
text: Your mission: fly around the Moon, study its far side, and come home.

speaker: houston
text: Four seats, four jobs. Pilot turns the ship. Life Support keeps the air safe.

speaker: houston
text: Comms & Power runs radio and batteries. Mission Planner does route and science.

speaker: houston
text: The Moon blocks radio. Behind it, you won't hear me. You'll be on your own.

speaker: houston
text: First, build your ship. Then fly it. Talk to each other, and you can get home.
